title: Jedi in Secret
description: A survivor of Palpatine's devastating Order 66, Jedi Padawan Kanan Janus went underground for many years, brandishing a conventional blaster as a weapon instead of his Lightsaber. He effectively led the Ghost crew, a small group of anti-imperial rebels, as the Galactic Civil War raged on. Jarrus soon took a keen interest in young orphan Ezra Bridger, part of the Ghost team and a Force-sensitive hero with an impactful destiny of his own ahead of him.
